page.overview:
Who is Egg of the Perfect World?

The was an outcast of society who became an apostle, watching over Albion. He acted as the catalyst to reconstitute Griffith into a corporeal form.

As a human, he was an outcast who lived in a trash dump, keeping himself out of sight in an underground tunnel. Hence, he was kind and sympathetic to the misshapen and downtrodden, granting the Demon Child peace by ingesting it and allowing the child to dream in the cradle of the new world within him. The apostle was cognizant of causality and played a role to further it. Seeing his life as something that should have never existed, he exchanged it for a better world, not for himself. Despite pondering on whether he could have been "somebody" had he met Mozgus and treated like his torturers, he came to the conclusion that his life existed to be looked down on.

Pseudo-apostle siring: his tentacles had needles that allowed him to sire pseudo-apostles, granting them the power they desired in order to nudge causality slightly.

Agile maneuverabilty: the Egg of the Perfect World was capable of jumping and running on walls, ceilings and the ground with ease. This was achieved through his tentacle-like arms and flexible legs, allowing him to escape his confrontations with the Skull Knight.
